A **Ren Restaurant** is one branch. Floors, staff, delivery zones and online ordering belong to it. Create one per branch; they can share the same company or not.

Open it from the **Restaurant** workspace → *Restaurant*, or search for "Ren Restaurant"."}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"General","key":"md_general","id":"general","name":"md_general","value":"# General

- **Restaurant Name**, **Logo**, **Description**: shown on the POS and on the guest ordering pages.
- **Active**: inactive restaurants disappear from the POS and from the staff's "Work at" list."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Menu","key":"md_menu","id":"menu","name":"md_menu","value":"# Menu

- **Active Menu**: the menu served by default. A room can have its own menu, and a menu with a schedule (breakfast, happy hour) takes over at its hours. See [Menus and items](/Docs/Menus%20and%20Items)."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"POS & Pricing","key":"md_pos_pricing","id":"pos-pricing","name":"md_pos_pricing","value":"# POS & Pricing

- **Default Price List**: when set, it prices every order of this restaurant instead of the POS Profile's price list.
- **POS Profile for orders**: orders taken by people who don't charge (servers, hosts) and online orders use this POS Profile for prices and taxes. Cashiers always charge with the POS Profile they are listed in. Empty: the restaurant's first POS Profile. See [POS Profile and charging](/Docs/POS%20Profile)."}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Table service","key":"md_table_service","id":"table-service","name":"md_table_service","value":"# Table service

**Who works a table** decides whose an occupied table is:

| Setting | What happens |
|---|---|
| **Own tables** (default) | An occupied table belongs to whoever opened its order. Anyone else needs the role permission *Work on other people's orders*, or a manager's PIN, to add to it or change it. |
| **Team service** | Everyone who works the table can see and change all of its orders. Good for small teams that share sections. |

Which tables someone works comes from their [staff record](/Docs/Staff%20and%20Roles)."}},{"node":"markdown106","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Operations","key":"md_operations","id":"operations","name":"md_operations","value":"# Operations

- **Company**: the ERPNext company the restaurant sells for.
- **Default Customer**: the walk-in customer put on new orders. A table with its own **Customer** (a regular, a house account) uses that one instead. Empty: the POS Profile's customer."}},{"node":"markdown107","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Delivery","key":"md_delivery","id":"delivery","name":"md_delivery","value":"# Delivery
